notes.title: Shops and Items Update
notes.content:
[b]Content and bugfixes:[/b]
[i]Added tons of melee weapons, potions, teleportation scroll and other items to the game[/i]
[i]Added shops on spawn and in the red forest[/i]
[i]Added chests on the mid river and in the purple forest to gain golds[/i]
[i]Added ability to farm gold by last hitting enemies[/i]
[i]Quality of life improvements so the game feels much smoother and comfortable to play[/i]
[i]Fixed all major bugs[/i]
